comments.author: Ravi
comments.text:
Hi Simon,

In speaking part 3, when examiner ask us question related to part 2, do i need to give answer with more than 3-4 sentences or there is any pattern??

comments.author: sjm
comments.text: Jenny - it's absolutely fine. In fact it's a good thing to be able to express different levels of certainly in the speaking test because that's what natives tend to do and it can show a nice range of spoken expressions. Remember, it's not a knowledge test.
